chapter_title: Concerning the Purification of these Four Elements
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

---

**¶2:** The four fundamental faculties of the spirit — love, truth, wisdom, and perception — [GAP-1] are what undergo regeneration. From their origin they are states of good, states of spiritual life, and states of illumination. Yet when they entered into [GAP-2] the first temptation-combat against evil, the residue of evil was [GAP-3] conjoined with them, and the falsity of hell was intermingled with their substance. And when these faculties descended into the natural and external person, casting off these corrupted external truths, they deposited them in the proprium — the selfhood. The corruptions which they have cast off shall be made manifest in a [GAP-4] state of exposure, and become a destructive force within the natural person.

---

**¶3:** The waste that self-love disgorges and deposits in the natural person is vitiated vital good — love perverted. The issue of perverted love is the eruption of falsity from evil. The issue of that eruption is the disordered states of the natural mind.

---

**¶4:** Likewise, the waste that corrupted truth discharges from itself is evil desire. The issue of evil desire is aversion to genuine truth. The issue of aversion to truth is the inflamed falsity that consumes the mind from within.

---

**¶5:** The waste that wisdom in its fallen state disgorges is the proprium — mere selfhood. The issue of the proprium is obscurity of understanding. [GAP-5] The issue of that obscurity is obstinacy — the hardened will that resists all divine influx.

---

**¶6:** The waste that corrupted perception disgorges — these are the persuasions and insinuating thoughts born of spiritual nakedness and shame. The issue of these persuasions of shame [GAP-6] is the final degree of spiritual degradation in this series.

---

**¶7:** The issue of [GAP-7] grief from spiritual anguish is the [GAP-8] consummation and sum of all these twelve corrupted states issuing from the fundamental faculties.

---

**¶8:** [GAP-9] These four fundamental spiritual faculties shall [GAP-10] receive back into themselves what is gathered in — what is discovered through the operation of this spiritual nourishment [GAP-11] that enters the natural person. When these truths of nourishment enter the external person, they are purified and reformed and established in their living divine form, which is the regenerate person. They shall live [GAP-12] in that renewed state, and receive the Divine Truth illuminating the understanding, and be purified in their proper divine image; and they come forth, having been cleansed and made holy. They attain their first celestial peace — the sabbath rest from which they originally fell.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The four elements [are what is] purified. From the beginning they are holy ones, living ones, and enlighteners. However, when they undertood [to fight] in that first struggle, the waste was [mixed] in with them, and the Darkness of the enemy was mixed with them. And when they were come into the body, stripping off these polluted garments, they set them in the flesh. Their pollutions, which they have stripped off, shall be displayed in a [visible form] and become a danger to the body.
The discharge of this pollution, that [the fir]e shall disgorge and place in the body, is [blo]od. The discharge of the blood is anger. The discharge of anger is the humours.
Also, the emissions that the waters discharge from them are lust. The discharge of lust is bitterness. The emission of bitterness is f[e]ver.
The emission that light shall disgorge is flesh. The emission of flesh is gloom. [The] emission of gloom is obstinacy.
The emissions that the tree shall disgorge, they are the voices of the winds of shame. The emission of winds of shame [is the tear]
The emission of the [tear] is the [completion] of these twelve emissions.

[Now] these four elements shall [receive] what are gathered in are [f]ound by the management of this soul food [that] enters the body. When they enter the body, they are cleansed and purified and established [i]n their living image, which is the new man. They shall live [anew] and receive the Light Mind and be purified in their image; and they come forth, being cleansed and holy. They attain their first rest.

fills.explanation: The editor's "are what is" correctly introduces "purified" — the four elements are the subject of purification/regeneration, matching the spiritual reading's "are what undergo regeneration."

The spiritual reading states "entered into the first temptation-combat against evil"; in the Kephalaia's natural register, the elements undertook "to fight" in the primordial struggle against Darkness.

The editor's "mixed" is confirmed — "mixed in with them" is the standard Kephalaia vocabulary for the conjunction of evil with the light elements, and the next clause uses the same word ("mixed with them").

The spiritual reading specifies "state of exposure"; in the Kephalaia's natural register of garment-stripping and bodily manifestation, the pollutions are "displayed in a visible form," meaning they become manifest to perception within the body.

The editor's "The" is confirmed — it follows the exact triadic pattern of every other element's emission chain ("The emission of X is Y"), and the spiritual reading confirms "The issue of that obscurity is obstinacy."

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the final degree of spiritual degradation in this series"; the tear (grief/anguish) completes the tree's second emission in its three-stage chain, and is confirmed by GAP-7's "tear" in the next paragraph.

The editor's "tear" is confirmed — the spiritual reading identifies this as "grief from spiritual anguish," and the tear is the tree's second emission whose own emission (the 12th) consummates all twelve.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the consummation and sum of all these twelve corrupted states"; in the Kephalaia register, "completion" denotes the final gathering and consummation of the twelve emission-chain, being the 12th and final emission.

The spiritual reading begins ¶8 directly with "These four fundamental spiritual faculties shall..."; "Now" is the standard Kephalaia transitional particle introducing a new phase of doctrinal exposition after the enumeration of emissions.

The spiritual reading states "shall receive back into themselves what is gathered in"; "receive" is the natural-plane term for the elements taking back the purified substance through the soul food's operation.

The editor's "that" is confirmed — it serves as the relative pronoun connecting "soul food" to "enters the body," matching the spiritual reading's "spiritual nourishment that enters the natural person."

The spiritual reading specifies "in that renewed state"; "anew" expresses renewal/regeneration in the Kephalaia's natural register, following their establishment in the "new man" and preceding their reception of the Light Mind.
